values: Standard Automation - Statement Generation and Reversal

1. User is signed in to Sage Intacct.
2. The correct Lending Management entity is selected.
3. Lending Management is enabled.
4. The user has the needed permission.
5. Required loan, customer, invoice, and setup records are active.
Navigation: Applications > Lending Management > Workbench / Statements | Client baseline | 24 test cases | Updated 2026-08-29
Allow Standard automation on a loan type

Loan Type ID: LT-STD-001
Statement Automation: Standard

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Loan Types
3. Click '+Create' (or open loan type LT-STD-001 for edit).
4. Enter 'LT-STD-001' in the Loan Type ID field.
5. Select 'Standard' in the Statement Automation field.
6. Click the 'Save' button.
7. Confirm that: The loan type saves successfully with Statement Automation set to Standard, and the value displays correctly on the loan type's View page.
The loan type saves successfully with Statement Automation set to Standard, and the value displays correctly on the loan type's View page.
Allow Statement presentment for Standard automation

Loan Type: Standard automation loan type
Presentment: Statement
Statement Repeats: Monthly

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Loan Types
3. Open a Standard-automation loan type's Edit page.
4. Select 'Statement' in the Presentment field.
5. Select 'Monthly' in the Statement Repeats field.
6. Click the 'Save' button.
7. Confirm that: The record saves successfully with Presentment set to Statement and Statement Repeats set to Monthly; no Invoice Repeats value is required or requested.
The record saves successfully with Presentment set to Statement and Statement Repeats set to Monthly; no Invoice Repeats value is required or requested.

Loan Type: Standard automation loan type
Presentment: Invoice & Statements
Invoice Repeats: Monthly
Statement Repeats: Quarterly

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Loan Types
3. Open a Standard-automation loan type's Edit page.
4. Select 'Invoice & Statements' in the Presentment field.
5. Select 'Monthly' in the Invoice Repeats field and 'Quarterly' in the Statement Repeats field.
6. Click the 'Save' button.
7. Confirm that: The record saves successfully with Presentment set to Invoice & Statements, Invoice Repeats set to Monthly, and Statement Repeats set to Quarterly, all displaying correctly on the View page.
The record saves successfully with Presentment set to Invoice & Statements, Invoice Repeats set to Monthly, and Statement Repeats set to Quarterly, all displaying correctly on the View page.

Require valid first statement and invoice dates

Origination Date: 08/01/2026
First Invoice Date: 08/31/2026
First Statement Date: 09/15/2026

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Loan Accounts
3. Click '+Create' to open a new Standard loan account.
4. Enter '08/01/2026' in the Origination Date field, '08/31/2026' in the First Invoice Date field, and '09/15/2026' in the First Statement Date field.
5. Click the 'Save' button.
6. Confirm that: The loan account saves successfully because the First Invoice Date and First Statement Date both fall after the Origination Date, and all three dates display correctly on the View page.
The loan account saves successfully because the First Invoice Date and First Statement Date both fall after the Origination Date, and all three dates display correctly on the View page.

4. Run the Standard process on 09/30/2026.
5. Confirm that: When the invoice and statement dates coincide, the process generates the statement before the invoice, and both artifacts are created correctly for the loan.

Carry the closing balance to the next statement

Period 1 Ending Balance: 950.00
Period 2 Beginning Balance: 950.00

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Workbench / Statements
3. Generate two consecutive statement periods for the same loan.
4. Open both statements and compare the ending and beginning balances.
5. Confirm that: Period 2's Beginning Balance (950.00) equals Period 1's Ending Balance (950.00), confirming the closing balance carries forward correctly.
Period 2's Beginning Balance (950.00) equals Period 1's Ending Balance (950.00), confirming the closing balance carries forward correctly.
Local multi-period automation checks balance carry-forward.

Block reversal when a later invoice exists

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Workbench / Statements
3. Create an invoice dated 10/15/2026 for the same loan as the 09/30/2026 statement.
4. Attempt to click 'Reverse' on the 09/30/2026 statement.
5. Confirm that: A validation message appears explaining that the statement cannot be reversed because a later invoice (10/15/2026) exists for the loan, and the reversal does not proceed.
A validation message appears explaining that the statement cannot be reversed because a later invoice (10/15/2026) exists for the loan, and the reversal does not proceed.
PR reference includes SNL-2034 and SNL-2035.
